screen.coi.tab_hotkeys_desc: Press a slot's key in-game to cast instantly. Your keys: %s. Rebind them in Options → Controls.
screen.coi.tab_wheel_desc: Hold [%s], point at a slot, release to cast.
screen.coi.tab_gestures_desc: Hold [%s], draw a shape with your mouse, release to cast.
screen.coi.ability_tooltip_blocked_hange: Blocked - you have been grazed by the Hanged Man
screen.coi.ability_tooltip_blocked_devou: Blocked - something is devouring this power
screen.coi.slot_inactive: Inactive - raise Key Slots in HUD Settings
notification.coi.menu_unsupported: This server does not support opening the menu from the client.
screen.coi.plate_supersedes: Replaces the madness, acting and reserve bars
screen.coi.health_supersedes: Replaces the vanilla hearts with your real HP
screen.coi.elements_hint: Show, scale and align each HUD element
screen.coi.reset_defaults.tooltip: Reset all settings to default values
screen.coi.layout_hint: Drag to move · Shift: free placement · Arrows: nudge · R: reset · Tab: next
screen.coi.layout_hint_one: Drag to move · Shift: free placement · Arrows: nudge · R: reset
screen.coi.menu_empty: This screen has nothing on it.
screen.coi.menu_use_server_hint: Opens the plugin's original inventory screens instead of the mod's own.
screen.coi.inv_hint_line1: The Mystery Arts item is gone from slot 9.
screen.coi.inv_hint_line2: Press %s to open the Beyonder menu.
screen.coi.inv_hint_line2_unbound: Bind "Open Beyonder Menu" in Controls to open it.
screen.coi.sheet_loading_hint: Your sheet is pushed from the server every few seconds. If nothing appears, this world is running without the Beyonder plugin - or you have not been awakened yet.
screen.coi.sheet_health_low: Critical - the next blow could be the last
screen.coi.sheet_spirit_sub: %s%% left - every ability is paid from here
screen.coi.sheet_spirit_low: Too little left to pay for most abilities
screen.coi.sheet_floor_godhood: Godhood %s%% - held for as long as the form is
screen.coi.sheet_floor_both: Permanent %1$s%% · godhood %2$s%% - neither clears on its own
screen.coi.sheet_outer: Outer pathways do not advance through acting.
screen.coi.sheet_outer_hint: There is no bar to fill here. An outer Beyonder's standing moves with what the story does to them, so this card stays empty by design.
screen.coi.sheet_sources_empty: Nothing recorded for this sequence yet.
screen.coi.sheet_limited_desc: Limited: your acting is being held back - some sources have already given everything they are allowed to.
screen.coi.sheet_overflow_desc: Overflow: acting earned past what this sequence needs is banked, and carries over once you advance.
screen.coi.sheet_foreign_desc: Foreign pathway: acting performed outside your own pathway counts for only part of its value.
screen.coi.sheet_life_death_desc: Line of Life and Death: the balance you hold between the two. It moves with what you kill and what you save.
screen.coi.sheet_pressure_desc: Frenzied Mage's Presence: stacks built up by casting nearby. They fade on their own once you stop.
screen.coi.sheet_anomaly_desc: Anomaly: something about your Beyonder state does not add up, and staff have been told. Nothing you do here will clear it.
screen.coi.sheet_nav_church_desc: Your congregation, its members and its standing.
screen.coi.sheet_nav_abilities_desc: Everything your sequence has taught you.
screen.coi.sheet_nav_mythical_desc: Take on the true shape of your pathway.
screen.coi.sheet_nav_uniqueness_desc: The trait that is yours and no one else's.
screen.coi.sheet_nav_honorific_desc: Claim the name the world will remember.
screen.coi.sheet_nav_map_desc: Choose who may find you on the map.
screen.coi.sheet_nav_seat_desc: Challenge for a vacant seat of your pathway.
screen.coi.sheet_lock_church: You belong to no church yet - join one or found your own first.
screen.coi.sheet_lock_abilities: You have no abilities to manage yet.
screen.coi.sheet_lock_mythical: Your pathway grants no form at this sequence.
screen.coi.sheet_lock_uniqueness: Uniqueness is granted further up the pathway.
screen.coi.sheet_lock_honorific: An honorific name is earned further up the pathway.
screen.coi.sheet_lock_map: The server is not offering map visibility to you.
screen.coi.sheet_lock_seat: No seat of your pathway is vacant to challenge for.
screen.coi.sheet_terrain_desc: Whether your abilities may break the world around you.
screen.coi.sheet_stage_desc_0: Your mind is entirely your own.
screen.coi.sheet_stage_desc_1: A faint pressure behind the eyes. Still easy to ignore.
screen.coi.sheet_stage_desc_2: The world flickers. Sounds arrive that no one else hears.
screen.coi.sheet_stage_desc_3: Hallucinations come often, and the HUD itself starts lying to you.
screen.coi.sheet_stage_desc_4: Control is gone. What is left of you is no longer steering.
screen.coi.sheet_tired_desc_1: The first drag on your movements.
screen.coi.sheet_tired_desc_2: Your body is asking for rest.
screen.coi.sheet_tired_desc_3: Everything costs more than it should.
screen.coi.sheet_tired_desc_4: You are running on nothing at all.
screen.coi.tour_step1_body: Your bound abilities live here. Each slot shows its icon, cooldown timer and keybind - empty until you bind something.
screen.coi.tour_step2_body: Press [%s] to open the binding screen and assign your abilities to slots.
screen.coi.tour_step3_body: Hold [%s] for quick access to even more abilities on a radial wheel - aim with the mouse, release to cast.
screen.coi.tour_step4_body: Watch this. When it climbs, you will start seeing things.
screen.coi.tour_step4_hidden: (The bar is currently hidden - enable it in HUD Settings.)
screen.coi.tour_step_spirit_body: Every ability spends spirituality. It refills on its own, and by default the bar fades away once you are back to full - change that in HUD Settings.
screen.coi.tour_step_acting_body: Acting is how you advance your sequence. This bar fills as you act in character, shows the cooldown between methods, and pops a +N whenever you earn some.
screen.coi.tour_step5_body: Customize everything - position, size, sounds - in HUD Settings, found on the binding screen.
title.coi.splash.3: The wheel of fortune keeps turning!
title.coi.splash.4: Do not gaze at the crimson moon!
title.coi.splash.6: The era of steam and machinery!
